The '''Deflector Chief''', also called '''chief shield officer''' or '''chief shields officer''',<ref name="TSWRC">''[[The Star Wars Rules Companion]]''</ref> was a section chief position aboard [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The chief was responsible for commanding the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector]] section. The Deflector Chief reported to the [[Weapons officer/Legends|Weapons Officer]].<ref name="FOP" />
